result.criticalFinding: The original designer/contractor portfolio exposes a dimensioned B&C Bakery Busan KTX proposal package containing a floor plan, reflected ceiling plan, elevations, zone areas, and an adjacent escalator/fire-door reference. The drawing package identifies the unit as 1F, 57.0 m2 and is dated 2021-10-25. It is proposal geometry with same-portfolio completion photos, not independent proof of the current or station-wide as-built condition.
result.safeUse: Use the package as a locally scaled tenant prototype and a candidate registration anchor. Do not place it in the current station shell until the exact escalator/fire-door/storefront is independently matched in current imagery or an operator plan.

phase1LocalMeasuredPrototype: Rectify the S1 floor-plan raster using the 7,490 mm and 8,127 mm visible outer dimension chains.
Re-transcribe all segment dimensions and reject any chain that does not close within raster-reading tolerance.
Build sales, service, and factory zones as a standalone 57.0 m2 proposal module; preserve front entrance and right escalator/fire-door adjacency as registration candidates.
Validate proposed elevations against same-portfolio completion photos before marking individual counters, doors, ceiling heights, or fixtures as implemented.
phase2CurrentRegistration: Acquire a dated current frame sequence containing at least three persistent features in one local coordinate neighborhood: escalator landing/void edge, fire door, storefront corners, ceiling-grid intersections, floor joints, structural columns, or fixed wayfinding.
Require two-way overlap: approach frames that connect a public station landmark to the storefront and reverse/side frames that close the local path.
Match only the tenant module translation/rotation to the official shell after the landmark set agrees; never scale the wider concourse from the tenant plan.
Use current KORAIL Retail north/south/new-waiting-room labels for semantic zones only until a metric operator map is acquired.

videoFramePass.procedure: Once media access succeeds, extract 1 fps proxy frames, then 5 fps around every escalator, shop fascia, public map, wayfinding sign, ticketing boundary, and repeated column bay. Record exact source timestamp and frame hash for each accepted landmark.
videoFramePass.acceptance: At least two overlapping views per landmark and one continuous chain from an official-shell feature to a tenant frontage. Reject moving kiosks, queue barriers, stock displays, and temporary signs as registration control points.
